1.explanation:
• index.en-us.md & index.md: describe NumberPicker props (defaultValue, step, precision) and overall usage. 
• demo/basic.md: shows the basic setup with defaultValue and step to reproduce initial state. 
• demo/step.md: demonstrates stepping behavior (step prop) same as in the bug. 
• demo/precision.md: illustrates the precision prop which should handle rounding—central to this issue. 
• theme/index.jsx: contains the rendering and value-formatting logic, key to understanding and fixing the display formatting for floats.
1.bug_scenario: In Safari, when using NumberPicker with defaultValue=4.02 and step=0.01 (with or without precision prop), clicking the "+" button increments the value but due to JavaScript floating-point precision it displays 4.029999999999999 instead of rounding to 4.03. The bug scenario image shows a NumberPicker control with “–” and “+” buttons surrounding a text input that shows the incorrect float result. Elements involved are the increment button, the numeric input display, and the component’s float-to-string formatting logic.
